name: Da Nang
provinceNote: Da Nang city now includes the former Quang Nam province, so Hoi An and My Son sit inside it.
dotReason: Worth a special trip in this corridor
summary: Central Vietnam’s beach city, with a long sandy shore, bridges over the river and mountains close by. Swim at My Khe, ride up to Ba Na, explore the Marble Mountains and the Son Tra peninsula, see the Dragon Bridge at night, and eat mi Quang noodles. One or two days suits families and beach lovers, and Hoi An is under an hour away.
timeNeeded: 1–2 days, plus nights if you prefer a beach hotel to Hoi An
fee: No single city ticket. The beach is free.
getThere: Da Nang International Airport (DAD) is a short ride from the river. Hoi An is about 30 minutes on from the Marble Mountains.
seoTitle: Da Nang travel guide — My Khe beach and An Thuong
seoDescription: Sleep on My Khe for the beach and a beachfront resort. An Thuong, just inland, is the night. Hoi An is under an hour when the old town is the point.
intro: Start on the sand. My Khe is a long city beach with the resort towers on the water and the surf as the morning. The swim is free. The city’s English page calls January to July the dry season, so that is the window for a beach week. Swim inside the buoy line, and only while a rescuer is on duty. A 2016 tourism page prints both 05:00–19:00 and 5am–8pm, and a 2023 city notice does not print a clock, so read the board on the sand. Chair hire is check on arrival.

The night is a short walk inland, on the streets just west of the sand. An Thuong is that quarter, bounded by Vo Nguyen Giap, Hoang Ke Viem, Chau Thi Vinh Te, and Ngo Thi Si: bars and kitchens close enough to wander between, which is why a beach hotel works after dark and a river hotel does not. On the sand itself, Kalà Kalà Beach Club at 51 Vo Nguyen Giap is open daily and entry is free. Its own site lists both midnight and 02:00 as closing, so confirm the night you go. East West Brewing’s beachfront taproom, on My Khe, pours from 08:00 to 01:00. The street number is not on that page.

If you slept on the river, the morning bowl is Huynh Thuc Khang, the breakfast street the city portal names. One page says it is crowded from 06:00 to 08:00. An earlier page prints 06:00–12:00, so go early and walk the counters. The night street paired with it is Pham Hong Thai. Han Market, by the swing bridge, and Con Market, around Hung Vuong and Ong Ich Khiem, are the two halls. Their door numbers do not match across city pages. Bach Dang is the promenade for a coffee and, on a weekend, the dragon. It is not a shop list.

Give a morning to the Cham Museum, on the Han River, when you want the stone before the swim. A general ticket is 60,000 VND and an hour is enough. The sculpture comes from My Son and the other Cham sites. The galleries are not the ruins. The door time is published as both 07:00 and 07:30, and both say it closes at 17:00, so confirm that morning. The Marble Mountains are about 15 minutes out, on the road you already take toward Hoi An. Climb Thuy Son. That hill is 40,000 VND.

Son Tra is the view that is not a theme park. The Quan The Am at Linh Ung is 67 meters and faces the sea, and the peninsula ride is half a day. No entry fee is published. Dragon Bridge is the weekend picture from the river path: fire and water at 21:00 on Friday, Saturday, and Sunday, not on an ordinary weeknight. Hai Van, north toward Hue, is a clear-weather detour. The train to Hue is about three hours if you would rather not drive the pass.
gettingAround: The airport is about 10–15 minutes from the center by car. Grab is the easy way across town. Sleep on My Khe if the beach is the trip: An Thuong is a walk inland, and the river is a ride. Sleep on the Han if you want the museum and Dragon Bridge on foot, and treat the beach as the outing. The Marble Mountains are about 15 minutes out, and Hoi An is about 30 minutes further by the coastal road. North–south trains stop at Ga Da Nang.

stayAreas.name: My Khe beach
stayAreas.summary: Sleep in a beachfront resort if the sea is why you picked the city. You wake up on My Khe. An Thuong’s bars and kitchens are a few streets inland, and the beach night is Kalà Kalà and East West.

stayAreas.name: Han River
stayAreas.summary: Sleep here if you want the museum, Dragon Bridge, and dinner on foot. The beach becomes a ride. That is a fair trade for a city morning, and a poor one if An Thuong after dark is the point.

eat: Lunch is mi Quang. Breakfast on the river is the Huynh Thuc Khang counters, and bun cha ca if you want one bowl. Dinner on My Khe is seafood along Hoang Sa, Vo Nguyen Giap, and Truong Sa. Ask the price before it is cooked. The drinks are on the sand and in An Thuong. The full menu is on the food guide.
interestsBody: Dining starts with mi Quang, the breakfast street, and seafood on the beach road. The food guide is the menu.

Beach lifestyle is the evening on the sand. Kalà Kalà is at 51 Vo Nguyen Giap, and East West faces the water. A coffee is that same sand. There is no separate photograph of either room, or of a beachfront coffee.
Beach sports are the boards, the paddle, the basket boats, and the other hire on My Khe. The price is check on arrival.
Nightlife is An Thuong, the lanes just inland of those four streets. The photograph is one doorway on An Thuong 4, not the whole grid.
Culture is the Cham Museum, the rooster church, the Marble Mountains, and Linh Ung on Son Tra. Each opens on its own photograph.
The river walk is Bach Dang for coffee, a young coconut, and the promenade, then the swing bridge and Han Market. Coconut is that walk, not a separate venue.
Resort living is Son Tra, Non Nuoc, and the My Khe and Vo Nguyen Giap beach resorts when the bed should be on the sand.

cards.title: Dining and F&B
cards.summary: Mi Quang, the breakfast street, and seafood on the beach road.

interestGroups.title: Shopping
interestGroups.summary: Fish sauce, dried food, clothes, and hand-sewn áo dài at Han Market. The frame is the produce wing.

blocks.heading: Han Market
paragraphs: The 28 September 2024 city page puts the hall near the swing bridge, between Trần Phú, Bạch Đằng, Hùng Vương, and Nguyễn Thái Học. It says the market was rebuilt in 1990 on two floors and about 3,000 m². It names shoes, clothes, bags, fabrics, and souvenirs, and says a hand-sewn áo dài can be picked up within an hour. The same page names fresh seafood, fruit, fish sauce, and dried central-coast food. This frame is the produce wing, under the sign for khu rau quả.

The 9 October 2023 markets page prints 119 Trần Phú and 06:00 to 19:00, and it names Nguyễn Văn Linh as the fourth street instead of Nguyễn Thái Học. The 2024 page prints no clock. Treat 06:00 to 19:00 as that 2023 line, and read the board. No gate fee is printed. The áo dài price is check on arrival.

blocks.heading: Stone at the foot of the hills
paragraphs: Non Nước, the stone-carving village at the foot of the Marble Mountains, was listed as national intangible cultural heritage in 2014. The city portal traces the craft to at least the 17th century. No village ticket is printed on the hill pages. The fee is check on arrival. There is no separate page, and no licensed workshop photograph was added here, so it is not a card.

blocks.heading: Night stalls with goods
paragraphs: The 9 October 2023 markets page describes souvenir stalls at the Sơn Trà night market and OCOP goods at An Thượng 4. On that page Sơn Trà is at Mai Hắc Đế, 18:00 to 23:00. VietnamPlus on 22 August 2025 says the market has been on the east bank of the Dragon Bridge since 1 August 2025 and does not print a close. Confirm the site that night. An Thượng 4 is printed as about 40 stalls, 17:00 to 23:00, free entry, on the 2023 page only. Neither has a licensed stall photograph here, so neither is a card. Eating at those stalls is the food guide.

cards.title: Han Market
cards.summary: Shoes, clothes, fabrics, souvenirs, and a hand-sewn áo dài on the 2024 page, plus fish sauce and dried food. This frame is the produce wing. The 2023 clock is 06:00 to 19:00. The 2024 page prints none. No gate fee is printed.

interestGroups.title: Resort Living
interestGroups.summary: InterContinental on Son Tra, Hyatt Regency at Non Nuoc, Pullman on My Khe, and Furama on Vo Nguyen Giap.

cards.title: Resort Living
cards.summary: Beach resorts named from their own sites, on Son Tra, Non Nuoc, and the My Khe sand.

interestGroups.title: Beach lifestyle
interestGroups.summary: Spend the evening on the sand, not in the lanes. Kalà Kalà and East West face the water, and the swim is the buoy line in front of them.

blocks.heading: Clubs and a coffee on the sand
paragraphs: Kalà Kalà Beach Club is at 51 Vo Nguyen Giap. Its own site says entry is free, and it lists both 08:00 to midnight and 08:00 to 02:00. Confirm which close is current the night you go.

East West Brewing’s beachfront taproom pours from 08:00 to 01:00 every day. That page says “by the shores of My Khe” and does not give a street number. Neither page prints a drink price. Ask before you order.

A coffee is a chair facing that water. No licensed photograph of either room, or of a beachfront coffee, was found, so the frames here are the sand those doors face. The lanes a few streets inland are An Thuong.

blocks.heading: The swim in front of the chairs
paragraphs: Swim only where the safety buoys are set and a rescuer is on duty. Do not swim in bad weather, where a danger board forbids it, or after the end-of-duty signal.

A 15 January 2016 beaches page says local beaches are swimmable all year, and especially from May to August, when the waves are gentle. That page prints two duty clocks: 5am to 8pm, and 05:00 to 19:00. A 12 April 2023 city notice names rescue teams on Hoang Sa, Vo Nguyen Giap, Truong Sa, and Nguyen Tat Thanh, and it does not print the hour. The board on the sand wins.
The beach is not on the city’s paid-ticket list. Chair and umbrella hire have no published price.

cards.title: Kalà Kalà and East West
cards.summary: Free entry at 51 Vo Nguyen Giap. The club lists both midnight and 02:00 as closing. East West is 08:00 to 01:00, and its street is check on arrival.

cards.title: The My Khe sand
cards.summary: Stand on the sand with the resort towers behind the chairs. Swim inside the buoy line, and only while a rescuer is on duty. The published duty clocks do not match, so read the board on the sand.

interestGroups.title: Beach sports
interestGroups.summary: Use My Khe for more than a swim. The 19 January 2016 city page names what you can hire. The prices on that list are not ones to budget.
body: The 19 January 2016 water-sports page names surfboards, skurfing, jet skis, sailing, parasailing, snorkeling and diving, basket-boat racing, and kayaks. The company phones on that page are a decade old and are not a list to call. Hire for a board, a boat, or a jet ski has no price on these pages.

For a lesson, the 2017 Vietnamese page puts Da Nang Surf School on Vo Nguyen Giap, inside Temple Danang, open 08:00 to 17:00, with a lesson of about two hours and stand-up paddle as well. The 2016 English page prints 119 Tran Phu, says open every day, prints both a one-hour visit and a lesson of about two hours, and still directs you to Vo Nguyen Giap. Confirm the meeting point that morning. The price line on the English page is a stub. The price is check on arrival. Do not use the one-dollar figure.

cards.title: Sports on My Khe
cards.summary: Surfboards, skurfing, jet skis, sailing, parasailing, snorkeling, diving, basket-boat racing, and kayaks, from the 19 January 2016 city page. Hire prices are check on arrival.

cards.title: Basket boats
cards.summary: The round boats on the sand are the racing that 2016 page names. A hire price for a boat is not printed. Check on arrival.

interestGroups.title: Nightlife
interestGroups.summary: Walk the lanes just inland of My Khe. The clubs on the sand are the beachfront page, not this one.
body: The quarter sits inside Vo Nguyen Giap, Hoang Ke Viem, Chau Thi Vinh Te, and Ngo Thi Si. Walk the lanes of bars and kitchens. This is not a bar list, and no door on these lanes has a published drink price here.
Kalà Kalà, at 51 Vo Nguyen Giap, and East West, open 08:00 to 01:00 on the sand, stay on the beach lifestyle page. The only licensed frame for these lanes is one doorway on An Thuong 4.

cards.title: An Thuong
cards.summary: The four-street quarter a few streets inland from a My Khe hotel. Go for the lanes after the swim. The photograph is one doorway on An Thuong 4, not the whole grid.

interestGroups.title: Culture
interestGroups.summary: A morning on the river for Cham stone, the pink church on Tran Phu, then the marble hill on the Hoi An road and Linh Ung on Son Tra.

blocks.heading: On the river and Tran Phu
paragraphs: Give the museum a morning on the river, before the beach takes the day. The rooster church is a separate door at 156 Tran Phu. Sunday is not in the visitor window.

blocks.heading: The hill and the peninsula
paragraphs: Climb Thuy Son if you are already on the Hoi An road. The elevator and Am Phu cave are separate tickets, and the other peaks are how a transfer morning falls apart. Linh Ung is a half-day on Son Tra, not a stop on the way to dinner.

cards.title: Cham Museum
cards.summary: Cham sandstone and terracotta from My Son and the other find-sites, in galleries on the river. A general ticket is 60,000 VND. The door is published as both 07:00 and 07:30. The stone is not the ruins.

cards.title: Rooster church
cards.summary: The pink church the city calls Con Ga, at 156 Tran Phu. Built in 1923, nearly 70 meters, in a Gothic form. From 1 January 2023 the parish sets visitors Monday to Saturday, 08:00 to 11:30 and 13:30 to 16:30. A fee is check on arrival.

cards.title: Marble Mountains
cards.summary: Climb Thuy Son, the marble hill on the road toward Hoi An. Caves, pagodas, and a lookout are the morning. Adults pay 40,000 VND for the hill. The elevator and Am Phu cave are separate.

cards.title: Linh Ung, Son Tra
cards.summary: The Quan The Am is 67 meters and faces the sea from Bai But. No entry fee is published, so check on arrival if a gate asks. Allow half a day. The ride out the peninsula is the visit.

interestGroups.title: River walk
interestGroups.summary: Coffee and a young coconut on Bach Dang, the bridge that turns for ships, and the market hall beside it.

blocks.heading: The promenade
paragraphs: Walk Bach Dang when you want the river, a coffee, and a young coconut in the same hour. The swing bridge and Han Market are that same walk. Watching from the bank is free. The two clocks for the turn do not match.

blocks.heading: The other bridges
paragraphs: Dragon Bridge is the weekend fire show, and it is not the swing bridge. Thuan Phuoc is where the Han meets the sea, on the way toward Son Tra.

cards.title: Bach Dang
cards.summary: The promenade of cafes, busy in the early morning and late afternoon, and crowded on a weekend when the dragon breathes fire. No cafe door hour is published. The walk itself is free.

cards.title: Swing bridge
cards.summary: It opened on 29 March 2000 and runs 487.7 meters from Le Duan to Pham Van Dong. The middle span turns about 90 degrees. The tourism page sets visitors from 23:00 to midnight on Saturday and Sunday, and also says about 23:00 every night. The city portal says about 01:00, back about 04:00. Watching from the bank is free.

cards.title: Han Market
cards.summary: The hall beside the swing bridge, for fruit, dried food, and a meal you eat in the building. The 2023 city page puts the door at 119 Tran Phu and the hours at 06:00 to 19:00. The 2024 page names the streets and prints no clock. No gate fee is published.

cards.title: Dragon Bridge
cards.summary: The yellow dragon over the Han. The show is at 21:00 on Friday, Saturday, and Sunday, and it is free from the bank. One page says about two minutes of fire and three of water. Another says the program runs about 10 to 15 minutes. Do not wait on a weeknight.

cards.title: Thuan Phuoc Bridge
cards.summary: The bridge where the Han meets the sea, on the way toward Son Tra. It opened to traffic on 19 July 2009 and the city page gives the length as 1,856 meters. One page joins Nguyen Tat Thanh to Hoang Sa and Truong Sa. The English page says Vo Nguyen Giap instead. No ticket and no viewing hour are published.

season.label: Drier beach months
season.note: The city’s English page calls January to July dry and August to December wet, with the heaviest rain in October and November. The Vietnamese page calls January to September dry and puts floods in September to November. Treat September as unsettled, and check the Hoi An road and Hai Van on the morning you go.

faqs.q: Should you stay in Da Nang or Hoi An?
faqs.a: Sleep in Da Nang if you want a beach morning, a resort on the sand, and An Thuong after dark. Sleep in Hoi An if the old town at night is the reason you came. See the other city as a ride, not as a second hotel move in the same day.

Huynh Thuc Khang, if you slept on the river. The city portal treats it as the breakfast street. One page says the busy hour is 06:00 to 08:00. An earlier page prints 06:00 to 12:00. Walk the counters. Bun cha ca is the other morning bowl, at the shops on the food guide.

A few streets inland from My Khe, in An Thuong, and on the sand itself. Kalà Kalà Beach Club is at 51 Vo Nguyen Giap, and entry is free. East West Brewing’s beachfront taproom is open 08:00 to 01:00. Dragon Bridge is the other evening, at 21:00 on Friday, Saturday, and Sunday.

faqs.q: When does Dragon Bridge breathe fire?
faqs.a: At 21:00 on Friday, Saturday, and Sunday, and on major holidays. It is not a weeknight show. During the fireworks festival the night can move, so check that week.
